recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future change to how current CarePlan.activity mixes performed and planned activities should be handled as a new Patient Care wording/model decision, not as remaining work for FHIR-3538.
issue_request: FHIR-3538 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU1. It asked for consistent tense in CarePlan.activity.simple descriptions, with Patient Care resolving that all activity properties except action resulting should be expressed in future tense.
initial_application: The 2015 git-svn commit db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 explicitly listed {#3538} among PC-approved CarePlan changes. That commit removed the old CarePlan.activity.simple shape from the CarePlan spreadsheet, kept actionResulting as the resulting-action exception, and made the activity/detail wording future-oriented.
additional_context: CarePlan remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Patient Care decisions changed the relevant activity model: FHIR-26064 renamed activity.outcome/reference/detail to performedActivity, plannedActivityReference, and plannedActivityDetail, and FHIR-39101 then removed the active plannedActivityDetail inline backbone in favor of plannedActivityReference.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current CarePlan source has no active CarePlan.activity.simple, activity.detail, or plannedActivityDetail path once XML comments are excluded; the active activity children are performedActivity, progress, and plannedActivityReference, reflecting later approved performed/planned semantics rather than an uncorrected FHIR-3538 tense inconsistency.

related_jiras.note: Renamed CarePlan activity elements to performedActivity, plannedActivityReference, and plannedActivityDetail, creating the current performed/planned split.
Removed the active plannedActivityDetail inline backbone, eliminating the remaining inline planned-activity element family descended from the old simple model.
